channel.title: Worth the Fee
channel.description: Straight answers on whether a travel card or program is worth it for you.

item.title: Rakuten Walmart cash back: does it work, and what is excluded?
item.description: Rakuten's Walmart page showed no cash back on November 25, 2026. A day earlier it showed a flat $5 on up to three orders. The offer comes and goes.

item.title: Rakuten sign-up bonus and referral bonus: how each works, what to spend, and what makes it fail
item.description: Read November 25, 2026: join by a member's link, then make $50 of purchases that earn cash back within 90 days. One bonus per person; offers change.

item.title: Rakuten Black Friday 2026: does Rakuten do Black Friday, and how the cash back works
item.description: Yes, Rakuten does Black Friday. On November 25, 2026 many stores showed raised cash back, such as 10% at Macy's (was 2%). Rates move daily.

item.title: Is Rakuten free to join and use, and what is the catch?
item.description: Yes, Rakuten is free: no fee to join or shop. One fee can apply after 12 idle months, and payment waits for a quarterly date and a $5 minimum.

item.title: Rakuten missing cash back or cash back not showing up: causes and how to submit a claim
item.description: Rakuten cash back not showing up after 48 hours? Check the store's exclusions, then submit the Missing Cash Back form within 90 days.

item.title: Rakuten Kohl's cash back: does Rakuten work at Kohl's and with Kohl's Cash?
item.description: Yes, Rakuten Kohl's cash back was 2% on November 25, 2026. Gift cards, Apple products and the part paid with Kohl's Cash earn nothing.

item.title: Rakuten Ulta cash back: does Rakuten work at Ulta, and what is excluded?
item.description: Yes, Rakuten works at Ulta: 2% on November 25, 2026. Dior, Marketplace items, gift cards and the part paid with Ulta rewards earn nothing.

item.title: Rakuten Apple cash back: is Apple on Rakuten, and what is excluded?
item.description: Yes, Apple is on Rakuten: 2% on November 25, 2026, only on accessories, refurbished items, AppleCare+ and Beats. New iPhones and Macs earn nothing.

item.title: Rakuten in store: can you use Rakuten in store, and how does in-store cash back work?
item.description: Yes, you can use Rakuten in store. Link a Visa, Mastercard or Amex card, add the store's offer first, then pay with that card. No receipt upload.

item.title: Rakuten or PayPal Honey: which one fits, and can you use both?
item.description: Rakuten pays cash or Amex points four times a year. Honey searches coupon codes and pays PayPal Rewards points. Only one is credited per order.

item.title: Is Ebates now Rakuten?
item.description: Yes. Ebates was bought by Rakuten in 2014 and took the Rakuten name in 2019. Accounts, balances and the way cash back works carried over.

item.title: Rakuten and Gap: how the cash back works and what is excluded
item.description: 2% on November 25, 2026, with no raised rate. Collabs, Gap Home, gift cards and third-party seller items are excluded.

item.title: Rakuten and Petco: how the cash back works and what is excluded
item.description: 2% online and 2% in stores on November 25, 2026. Grooming, training, pharmacy, gift cards and repeat deliveries after the first are excluded.

item.title: Rakuten and SHEIN: how the cash back works and what is excluded
item.description: 6% on November 25, 2026 (usual rate 2%). Gift cards, subscriptions and the redemption of SHEIN reward points are excluded.

item.title: How does TopCashback work, step by step, for a first purchase?
item.description: Search for the store on TopCashback, click Get Cash Back, buy as usual. It shows within about 7 days and takes 1 to 3 months to become available.

item.title: TopCashback app: how does it work on iPhone and Android?
item.description: The free TopCashback app lets you shop stores, watch your earnings and cash out from a phone. It says cash back can take up to 6 weeks to show.

item.title: TopCashback browser extension: how does it work and what does it see?
item.description: The free TopCashback extension shows a pop-up on stores that pay cash back. It reads site addresses, not your searches, by its own privacy notice.

item.title: Rakuten cash back rates today, by store (November 25)
item.description: The headline Rakuten cash back rate at 70 large stores, read from Rakuten's store pages on November 25, 2026, with what changed since the last reading.

item.title: How does TopCashback pay you, and when can you cash out?
item.description: You can cash out any time once cash back is marked available: to a bank, Venmo, PayPal or a gift card. Each store sets how long that takes.

item.title: TopCashback Highest Cash Back Guarantee: how does the 110% match work?
item.description: If one of seven named sites shows a higher rate the day you buy, TopCashback says it pays 110% of that rate. You must claim within seven days.

item.title: Is TopCashback legit and free, and how does it make money?
item.description: TopCashback is a real cash back site with no fee. It says it passes on 100% of store commissions and earns from store bonuses and ads.

item.title: Rakuten Temu cash back: does it work, and what is excluded?
item.description: Yes: 2% on November 24, 2026, on orders up to a $250 cart. Temu app orders, phones, tablets, laptops and carts filled before the click are excluded.

item.title: Rakuten Costco cash back: does it work, and what works instead?
item.description: No. On November 24, 2026, Rakuten's Costco page showed coupons only, with no cash back. Costco's own 2% Reward and card rewards still apply.

item.title: Rakuten Macy's cash back: does it work, and what is excluded?
item.description: Rakuten Macy's cash back was 10% on November 24, 2026 (usual 2%), with 1.5% on furniture, electronics and marketplace items. No gift cards.

item.title: Rakuten Best Buy cash back: does it work, and what is excluded?
item.description: Rakuten Best Buy cash back was up to 8% by category on November 24, 2026; most items earn 1%. Apple, game consoles and gift cards earn nothing.

item.title: Rakuten Sam's Club cash back: what earns 9%, what earns 3%, and what is excluded?
item.description: Yes. On November 24, 2026: 9% on new memberships (usual 4%) and 3% on eligible items (usual 1%). Groceries, renewals and Scan & Go earn nothing.

item.title: Rakuten Lululemon cash back: does it work, and what works instead?
item.description: Not on November 24, 2026: Rakuten's lululemon page read "No Cash Back". Lululemon eGift cards from Giftcards.com showed 3% the same day.

item.title: Rakuten PetSmart cash back: does it work, and what is excluded?
item.description: Yes: 10% on November 24, 2026 (usual rate 2%). Pharmacy items, vet care, gift cards and repeat Autoship orders are excluded.

item.title: Rakuten Etsy cash back: does it work, and what is excluded?
item.description: Yes: 1% on November 24, 2026, with no category tiers. Gift cards and shipping labels bought by Etsy sellers are the only exclusions listed.

item.title: Rakuten Dyson cash back: does it work, and what is excluded?
item.description: Yes: 10% online on November 24, 2026 (usual rate 1%), and 1% in store. Refurbished machines, parts and accessories are excluded.
